guide.text: Increases HP and Attack. Superman's Attack bonus scales with the number of allies present, and the Razor Rib Umbrella gives him a consistent boost in battle.
Increases HP and Attack. Harley Quinn gains Energy on kills, and the Attack bonus helps her defeat enemies faster, creating an effective damage-and-energy loop.
Balances Attack and Physical Defense so Batman can deal solid damage and hold his ground in melee, making it a versatile choice for many events.
Increases HP and Attack, giving Catwoman a stronger foundation so she can deal solid damage even before she starts stealing enemy Attack.
Increases HP and Attack. Scarecrow gains damage reduction upon casting his Ultimate, and the Attack bonus makes his spiritual damage skills more threatening.
Hawkgirl relies on high Max HP to strengthen her [Nth Metal Aegis], and this weapon's base stats fit her core playstyle well.
Increases HP and Attack. Supergirl's survivability and damage scale with the number of [Superman Family] allies present, and the Razor Rib Umbrella's bonuses enhance this scaling.
Increases HP and Attack, helping Atom survive longer and stack more Attack. Even if he's defeated, his passive skill deals damage and stuns nearby enemies.
Increases HP and Attack. Queen Hippolyta takes much less damage after casting her Ultimate, and the Attack bonus lets her deal massive damage while protecting allies.
Boosts both offense and survivability, allowing Swamp Thing to hit harder and withstand more damage.
Increases HP and Attack. Since Wonder Woman Death Metal restores Energy when an enemy is defeated nearby, the Attack bonus helps her defeat enemies and restore Energy faster.

Grants basic HP and Attack bonuses. Cassandra Cain benefits from both the added survivability and the boost to base damage, making this Legacy Piece a solid transitional option for the early to mid game.
Provides steady HP and Defense bonuses to improve Mr. Freeze's baseline durability across all modes, making it a solid all-purpose transitional option.
Grants bonus HP and base Defense, helping Batman last through longer fights and survive focused fire until his crit and smoke bomb cycle ramps up.
Provides reliable Attack and Crit Rate bonuses. A solid all-purpose choice that gives Harley Quinn consistent damage before her Legacy Piece is ready.
Grants steady HP and Attack bonuses, improving Supergirl Woman of Tomorrow's survivability and healing. A reliable setup while you build toward stronger gear.
Boosts Attack and HP for reliable all-around performance.
Boosts HP and Attack, balancing durability with damage in Beast Boy's animal forms.
Boosts Robin's overall stats and helps him stay effective in longer fights.
